name: Resource Recovery Marketplace
notes: Lists surplus materials with an AI or template listing and a required safety tick, matches each listing to a 12-group sample reuse register (AI or keyword), drafts the offer email and records collections and tonnes kept from landfill; the register can now be viewed and added to, with consent, and shows which open listings suit each group, assuming groups sign up through council rather than directly. Reviewed for the brief and manager ready.
desc: Matches surplus council and business materials with community groups, schools, makers and businesses that can reuse them. AI writes the listing and ranks likely takers, a waste officer confirms safety, and the page tracks offers, collections and tonnes kept from landfill.
tested: Playwright at 1280x800 light and 390x844 dark with no page or console errors and no horizontal scroll: offer, Copy text with Draft in Outlook beside it, send offer, collection weight validation and stats, reuse register view, add-group validation and success, reverse match chip opening a listing, template listing and publish with the safety tick, empty filter state, productionise panel, All AI prototypes button and visible keyboard focus; AI path with a stand-in for listing writing and matching (bad ids dropped, names, phone and email masked out of all prompts).
